description: This file defines the ViewListBuilder class for building and rendering a list of view entities in Drupal's Views UI module, including methods for loading, building rows, headers, operations, and retrieving display lists.

classes.name: ViewListBuilder
classes.description: A class to build and render a list of view entities in Drupal's Views UI module.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ViewListBuilder using the container and entity type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the display manager and disables pagination for client-side filtering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads view entities and separates them into enabled and disabled lists.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a render array for a view entity row, including name, machine name, description, displays, and operations.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the views listing table.

methods.name: getDefaultOperations
methods.description: Defines default operations (edit, duplicate, enable, disable) for each view entity, adding AJAX support.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the complete views list with filters, enabled/disabled sections, and tables.

methods.name: getDisplaysList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of display types included in a view, with links to their paths if available.
